family_reports.body: The Idaho family court system has taken valuable time away from me and my son, and from him and his siblings. It has profoundly changed the course of all of our lives.The system does not care about facts or the law, Judges and attorneys make decisions based on their personal feelings and beliefs.
I went to the court for help protecting myself and my children after my abuser almost killed me. Instead we got more exposure and abuse. I feel more helpless than I did when I was living with him.
